title_sq: Shitet, Ambient Biznesi Dublex, i investuar si Bar-Kafe, Oxhaku, 180.000 Euro
description_sq:
Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Ambient biznesi
– Rruga Belul Hatibi
– Zona Oxhak
– Kati 0
— I investuar si bar kafe
– Siperfaqja 62.3 m²
– Cmimi 180,000 Euro
Shitet Ambient biznesi, me siperfaqe 62.3m2, i pozicionuar ne katin 0 te nje pallati te ri. Ambienti eshte i projektuar si Duplex duke shfrytezuar maksimalisht per qellimin e biznesit te gjithe siperfaqen e prones. Disponon 2 tualete.
Ambienti ka fasade xhami dhe eshte i larte 4m.
Ambienti eshte i investuar ne detaje si bar kafe, duke perfshire shtrimin me parket, tavolinat dhe karriget (si per hapesiren brenda ashtu dhe per hapesiren e jashtme), banakun, ndricimin, sistemin e aspirimit, sistemin e kondicionimit, televizoret etj.
Ambienti i biznesit nuk eshte shfrytezuar asnjehere si lokal. Cdo pajisje dhe mobilje eshte e re.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Nuk shitet me financim kredie.
Per me shume informacione ose per një vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjenscise imobiliare!
title_en: For sale, Duplex Business Environment, invested as Bar-Cafe, Fireplace, 180,000 Euro
description_en: Property characteristics: - Business area - Belul Hatibi Street - Chimney area - Floor 0 - Invested as a coffee bar - Area 62.3 m² - Price 180,000 Euro Business area for sale, with an area of ​​62.3m2, located on the 0th floor of a new building. The environment is designed as a Duplex, making maximum use of the entire surface of the property for business purposes. It has 2 toilets. The environment has a glass facade and is 4m high. The environment is invested in details such as brown grass, including parquet flooring, tables and chairs (for both indoor and outdoor space), counter, lighting, aspiration system, air conditioning system, televisions, etc. The business environment has never been used as a bar. Every appliance and furniture is new. The property has regular mortgage documentation. Not sold with credit financing. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
